ja227:1.1: A hero comes across a hero,
ja227:1.3: Come, O Nāga, turn back again,
ja227:1.4: why do you run away in fear?”
ja227:1.5: See, (people of) Aṅga and Magadha, my heroism and yours.
ja227:2.1: Not with my feet will I kill you, not with my tusks, not with my trunk,
ja227:2.3: I will kill you with excrement,
ja227:2.4: the rotten will kill the rotten.
